verdict.rationale: Requesty is itself an OpenAI-compatible API, with documented base URLs and SDK drop-in usage. It publishes an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec covering both the inference router and a management API (api-v2), with an interactive per-endpoint playground, generated code samples, and a dated changelog with deprecation migration paths. The probe's 404s were at different candidate paths than the advertised api-reference/openapi.json, so they do not contradict the spec's existence. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the management API end-to-end, and a stated versioning or back-compat policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
